data_type: SYNTHETIC; actual C controllers and actual C protocol quantization, no motor traffic
common_load_scope: same assumed J=.039/B=.30 plus constant +.15 N.m and smooth Coulomb .06 N.m; not a motor-specific typical gimbal
motor_comparison_scope: assess original/new within each motor; differing motor limits and sensors are not a controller-treatment difference
integral_comparison_scope: when a profile enables integral, Original core is the preserved Ki0 baseline and Original core (same Ki) gets the identical tuned integral; distinguish configuration improvement from core-only improvement
envelope_scope: DM piecewise line through assumed (0,7 N.m), rated (120 rpm,3 N.m), no-load (200 rpm,0); GM source-derived 320/156 N.m zero-speed intercept; current cap and braking-only cap; no thermal/regeneration model
protocol_scope: wire torque is passed to the delayed actuator; observer still uses last controller command; DM zero torque is not exactly representable
feedback_scope: zero-centered uniform quantization after an assumed calibration, not bit-exact feedback CAN replay; raw DM MIT zero lies at a half-bin

comparison_contract.flags: Only original soft/hard limit and slew flags map to bits 0 and 1
comparison_contract.integral: Config k_integral maps directly; use zero for the primary comparison
comparison_contract.nonfinite_policy: Do not filter original inputs or outputs

profile.nominal_model_scope: Teaching/reference model, not a measured typical RoboMaster gimbal; same load for controlled motor comparison.
required_hardware_verification: allowable torque, current, speed and temperature
timestamps, measured loop timing and drive watchdog

actuator_dynamic_assumptions.note: Illustrative actuator lag; not the datasheet mechanical time constant.

profile.name: gm6020_current_v1_4

protocol.scope: Simulation assumes current mode is enabled. Hardware requires firmware >=1.0.11.2 and Assistant >=2.7 current-loop switch, verified explicitly.

motor.scope: Linear speed/torque approximation plus application limit; not a thermal model. Maximum continuous torque is not continuous stall torque.

tuning_scope.slow_integral_rule: Ki=2*Kposition, torque integral cap=0.2 N.m, tracking rate=2/s; nominal integral time scale=0.5s.
tuning_scope.selection: Selected on development seeds 4310..4314 and explicitly reported stress tests, before validation seeds 4315..4319.
tuning_scope.attribution: Primary original baseline retains Ki=0. Also run unchanged upstream C with this same integral configuration to separate tuning from kernel effects.
tuning_scope.timing_scope: Nominal assumed command delay is 1 ms plus 2 ms actuator lag. 10 ms delay and saturated high-frequency cases include regressions; no all-delay or hardware claim.
tuning_scope.filter: Velocity error filtering is disabled; the tested 2 ms filter did not pass development performance criteria.
